neighbours.label: direction words used for an abstract ordering or approach (bottom up, from above, backwards, nach oben)
fire: When I value a company I usually build the model from the bottom up.
The reforms were imposed from above by a small circle of ministers.
Detectives often reason backwards from the crime to the suspect.
The engineers designed the system top-down, starting from the user's needs.
Change in the party came from below, through local branches.
Instead of planning forwards, she worked backwards from the deadline.
The union wanted decisions to flow upward from the shop floor.
Das System muss sich nach oben und nach unten öffnen.
quiet: When I value a company I usually build the model in a spreadsheet.
The reforms were imposed quickly by a small circle of ministers.
Detectives often reason carefully about the crime and the suspect.
The engineers designed the system slowly, starting from the user's needs.
Change in the party came gradually, through local branches.
Instead of planning loosely, she worked steadily toward the deadline.
The union wanted decisions to be shared with the shop floor.
Das System muss sich für neue Bewerber öffnen.

notes: card: '-up' x4, backwards x2, down x2, oben, above; mostly metaphorical directions of reasoning or reform. Near misses describe the same activities without a direction word.
